test_title: PYST 4: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 17th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some stars are planets.

Some planets are comets.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some comets are planets.

II. All stars are comets.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow
Neither conclusion I nor II follows

solution:
The least possible diagram is as follows:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/5c335d328cbaed6c4c65a34da62553db0cb5d31d71e04a03c2ea3daa4d03bbcc.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some comets are planets → True (as some planets are comets)

II. All stars are comets → False (it is possible but not definite as shown in the diagram above)

Hence, **only conclusion I follows.**
